name: Configuration.createFromParcel
author: M66B, akano12
description: The mobile country and network code (MCC and MNC) of the configuration of the app become 0, like the operator of the test network which Use.Tracking shows. Apps select resources by them, like of a country or operator, which they do not get then. Formerly a built-in definition, which was disabled.

-- The mobile country and network code of the configuration, which apps use to select resources

function after(hook, param)
    local configuration = param:getResult()
    if configuration == nil or (configuration.mcc == 0 and configuration.mnc == 0) then
        return false
    end
    configuration.mcc = 0
    configuration.mnc = 0
    return true
end
